hero.title: 16 Years of Experience and Trust
hero.text: Since the founding of Abdul Wahid Motors 16 years ago, the company has chosen to make customer satisfaction, service quality, and credibility the foundation of its operations.

story.title: A journey through difficult years
paragraphs: Throughout its years of operation, the company continued its activities under difficult and complex circumstances, maintaining its presence and strong relationships with customers in Damascus and several other provinces.

Following the liberation, the company entered a new phase of expansion, focusing more heavily on the BYD brand to build an integrated ecosystem that goes beyond car sales to encompass comprehensive after-sales services.

network.title: Two branches in Damascus, expanding step by step
network.text: The company currently operates through two branches in Damascus, with a plan to expand gradually across Syrian provinces to bring its services closer to customers and build a wider network for servicing BYD vehicles.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be one of the most reliable and specialized companies in the field of BYD cars and services in Syria, and to build an integrated network that makes car ownership easier, safer, and more comfortable.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide an integrated experience that starts with choosing the car and goes far beyond its delivery, through responsible selling, specialized technical service, genuine spare parts, robust warranties, and continuous communication with the customer.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about us

items.q: Is Abdul Wahid Motors an authorized BYD dealer?
items.a: Yes. We are the authorized BYD dealer in Damascus, offering sales, service and genuine spare parts.

items.q: How do I reserve a car?
items.a: Pick a car on the cars page and send a reservation request on the website. Our sales team contacts you to confirm availability, agree the details and arrange payment.

items.q: Can I book a service appointment on the website?
items.a: Yes. Choose the service, branch, day and exact time, and our team will contact you to confirm.

items.q: How do I know the condition of my Blade battery?
items.a: We inspect Blade batteries and issue a digital certificate that anyone can verify through a link or the QR code printed on the report.
After we receive your request, our sales team contacts you and arranges payment with you directly: at the branch, by bank transfer or by mobile wallet.

contact.title: We'd love to hear from you
contact.text: Write to us, call us or follow us on our channels.

hero.title: Service for your car, to the manufacturer's standards
hero.text: From periodic service to Blade battery checks, our technicians look after your car at the Sahnaya and Kafr Sousa branches, and you follow the service history and invoices from your account.

battery.title: Digital battery inspection and a verifiable certificate
battery.text: We measure the condition of your Blade battery and record the results in a report you can open in your account, with a certificate anyone can verify through a link or QR code.
items: State of health (SOH) and state of charge (SOC)
